sources.title: March 2010 Lists (TCG) - Yugipedia
sources.revision: pageid 328998, wikitext fetched via the MediaWiki parse API

sources.title: What is Edison Format? - EdisonFormat.com
sources.used_for: Format name origin (75th SJC, Edison NJ, April 24-25 2010) and duration (March 1 - May 10, 2010, ending the day before The Shining Darkness's NA release).

sources.title: Legal Sets - EdisonFormat.com
sources.used_for: Card pool boundaries: last core set ABPF (2010-02-16 NA), side sets through DPKB (2010-04-20), SDMM (2010-02-23), Europe-only RP01/GX06 legality, promo cutoffs (Dark End Dragon SJCS-EN007, Cyber Eltanin JUMP-EN038, Elemental Hero Absolute Zero YG04-EN001).
sources.reliability_notes: Omits Duelist Pack Collection Tin 2010 (DPCT, source of Starlight Road) from its table even though the site's own pool link includes Starlight Road; see formats/2010-03-edison/notes.md.

sources.title: Edison Rule Differences - EdisonFormat.com
sources.used_for: Statement that SJC Edison was played under the 'TCG 2008 Rules Change (the equivalent of Master Rules)' plus 13 catalogued rule differences vs modern play.

sources.title: Format Library - Edison format record (live API)
sources.used_for: Format Library's Edison definition: date 2010-04-24, banlist 'March 2010' (TCG), eventName 'SJC Edison - April 2010', chronology naming (previous 'Lightsworn', next 'Frog'), Starlight Road note.

sources.title: Format Library - March 2010 TCG banlist (live API)
sources.used_for: Independent cross-check of the March 2010 TCG list membership; matched the Yugipedia transcription exactly (43 forbidden / 70 limited / 19 semi-limited).
sources.reliability_notes: Format Library's 'previous status' change-markers were found unreliable in three cases (Destiny Draw, Royal Decree, Dark Strike Fighter); statuses themselves matched.

sources.title: Duelist Pack Collection Tin 2010 - Yugipedia

sources.title: Yugipedia set pages (Semantic MediaWiki release-date properties, per territory)
sources.notes: Queried per the published API policy (1 req/s, descriptive UA, cached). Exact queries, retrieval dates, and page counts are stamped into data/imported/releases-report.json by the importer. Date precision parsed from SMW raw values (1/YYYY[/M[/D]]), never from padded timestamps.

sources.title: YGOPRODeck API v7 bulk dumps (cardinfo.php?misc=yes, cardsets.php)
sources.notes: Single-request bulk download per their stated caching mandate. Printings/identity authority only: its per-set tcg_date is region-inconsistent (verified EU for some sets, NA for others), so it corroborates or falls back, never overrides Yugipedia dates. Retrieval stamped in data/imported/releases-report.json.

sources.title: Konami US/EU product pages, 2010 (Internet Archive) - Launch Date and Konami Tournament Legal Date fields
sources.notes: Period captures verifying the Edison boundary dates: ABPF US 2/16 (web.archive.org/web/20100208145649/http://www.yugioh-card.com/en/products/bp-abpf.html), ABPF UK 02/12 (…/20100202041527/…/uk/products/bp-apf.html), SDMM US 2/23 (…/20100208205100/…/en/products/sd-mm.html), SDMM UK 02/19 (…/20100129132136/…/uk/products/sd18.html), DPCT US 3/09 (…/20100208100547/…/en/products/tin-dp2010.html), DPKB US 4/20 (…/20100130/…/en/products/…kaiba), DPKB UK 04/16 (…/20100313160557/…/uk/products/kaiba.html), TSHD US 5/11 (…/20100214180551/…/en/products/bp-tshd.html), TSHD UK 05/07 (…/20100313160412/…/uk/products/shining.html), TSHD Sneak Peek 'May 1 and/or May 2' (…/20100425040441/…/en/events/sp/tshd-sneak.html), Europe 'April 30th to May 2nd' (Konami-EU news capture 2010-05-13). Local copies under the research cache; retrieved 2026-08-20.

sources.title: 75th Shonen Jump Championship (Edison, NJ) official FAQ - card legality for the event (captured 2010-04-11)
sources.notes: Konami's own pre-event legality statement: SJ promos 'up until Hundred Eyes Dragon', GX manga promos through Angel O7, video-game promos through the Reverse of Arcadia trio, boosters through Absolute Powerforce and Duelist Pack Kaiba ('Legal for play starting 4/20/2010'), Machina Mayhem, plus an explicit list of Duel Terminal exclusives NOT legal.

sources.title: UDE Tournament Appendix A: Yu-Gi-Oh! Policies (Nov 2005 / Apr 2006 / Aug 2008 revisions, archived)
sources.notes: Period tournament-legality rules for the UDE era: 'Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG cards become tournament-legal around the world at the same time' (worldwide-simultaneous legality outside Asia); OCG/Asian-English cards banned; foreign-language TCG cards legal with translation; Currently Legal Promotional Cards lists include Europe-only products (MC1/MC2, ML01-03, UE02) and 'DTP1 (reprints)'. Local copies cached in the research cache; retrieved 2026-08-20.

sources.title: Konami premier-event card-legality FAQs 2009-2010 (US Nationals 2009, Regionals, 2010 US WCQ; archived) and the 2010-03-19 Duel Terminal legality article
sources.notes: Konami-era legality practice: per-event dated legal lists. Evidence that Europe-only GX Tag Force 3 promos (Gallis the Star Beast, Red-Eyes Wyvern, Darkness Destroyer) were explicitly legal at US premier events 2009-2010, and that Duel Terminal machine-exclusive cards were NOT legal until released in another product (mid-2009 FAQs naming Ally of Justice Catastor; Kevin Tewart's 2010-03-19 strategy-site article; the June 2010 US WCQ FAQ enumerating still-illegal DT01/DT02 numbers). Local copies cached; retrieved 2026-08-20.
